column1: # Rule: a layer blend on a one-value channel, by the blend id stored in the project file.
# result = lerp(base, f(base, top), strength); on a 0..1 channel (clamp 1) f is clamped to 0..1 before the lerp, a
# float channel (clamp 0) does not clamp. f per id: the measured formula table. On one-value channels Tint, Saturation
# and Color keep the base; Value and the three normal-map modes take the top.
# Source: measurement "Format 92 and the measured blend table" > "Blend modes" (formula table; "Strength w on 16-bit
# channels"). Measured: every id 0.000-0.001 of an 8-bit step, 100% within 1, on 16-bit gray.
# fit: exact = measured to the tolerance above; unmeasured = float rows the reference was not fitted on (ids 19-22, 25).
# Tolerance: 1e-6 absolute. NaN means NaN (SoftLight under a negative base, as measured).
# Columns: id = stored blend id (format data); name = the mode's API name; base, top = values; strength = opacity x
# coverage; clamp = 1 for a 0..1 channel, 0 for a float channel; expected = result.
